title: Missing Encounter Location Reference Element
guidance: Encounter.location.location.reference is required for reporting to NHSN. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

matcher.regex: Encounter\.location\.location\.reference: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing ServiceRequest Encounter Reference Element
guidance: ServiceRequest.encounter.reference is required for reporting to NHSN. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

matcher.regex: ServiceRequest\.encounter\.reference: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Observation Performer Element
guidance: Observation.performer element was found to be missing,  it is not required for reporting to NHSN. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

matcher.regex: Best Practice Recommendation: In general, all observations should have a performer

title: Invalid Data Type Found in MeasureReport populationDescription Extension
guidance: The measurereport-populationDescription extension is defined to carry a markdown value, but the submitted resource supplies a different data type. Please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket for resolution.

matcher.regex: The Extension 'http://hl7\.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/measurereport-populationDescription' definition allows for the types \[.+\] but found type \w+

title: MeasureReport populationDescription Extension Used at Disallowed Location
guidance: The measurereport-populationDescription extension was placed at a point in the MeasureReport where the profile does not permit it. The extension is only allowed on the group, group.population, stratifier, and supplementalData elements. Please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket for resolution.

matcher.regex: The extension http://hl7\.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/measurereport-populationDescription v[\d.]+ is not allowed to be used at this point \(.+\)

title: MeasureReport supplementalData description Exceeds Maximum Cardinality
guidance: The supplementalData extension on the MeasureReport carries more than one criteriaReference extension, but the DEQM profile permits at most one. This must be resolved by NHSN, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket for resolution.

matcher.regex: MeasureReport\.extension:supplementalData\.value\[x\]\.extension:description: max allowed = \d+, but found \d+ \(from http://hl7\.org/fhir/us/davinci-deqm/StructureDefinition/indv-measurereport-deqm\|[\d.]+\)

title: Missing ServiceRequest authoredOn Element
guidance: ServiceRequest.authoredOn Element was found to be missing, and it is required for reporting to NHSN. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

matcher.regex: ServiceRequest\.authoredOn: minimum required = \d+, but only found \d+ \(from http://www\.cdc\.gov/nhsn/fhirportal/dqm/ig/StructureDefinition/ach-daily-servicerequest\|[\d.]+\)

title: MeasureReport supplementalData criteriaReference Exceeds Maximum Cardinality
guidance: The supplementalData extension on the MeasureReport carries more than one criteriaReference extension, but the DEQM profile permits at most one. This must be resolved by NHSN, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket for resolution.

matcher.regex: MeasureReport\.extension:supplementalData\.value\[x\]\.extension:criteriaReference: max allowed = \d+, but found \d+ \(from http://hl7\.org/fhir/us/davinci-deqm/StructureDefinition/indv-measurereport-deqm\|[\d.]+\)

title: Missing Valid Procedure statusReason Code
